dialogue_texts: Reimu
Is that it? I've got things to do and a shrine to get back to.
Reimu
Are you going to talk, or do we go for round two?
Camille
You have a tenacity that is as annoying as it is effective, shrine maiden.
Camille
Very well. My daughter isn't missing in the way you fear.
Reimu
Stop the cryptic games. Where is she?
Camille
She is currently in no man's land, where the barrier is thinnest.
Camille
She's trying to understand why you rubbed the curse of glohm off some maid.
Reimu
Typical. Always making things more complicated than they need to be.
Camille
At the very edge of the world, she isn't just looking for answers.
Reimu
No man's land isn't an actual location. I have no time to do extra searching.
Reimu
In that case, I'll just go back to the Hakurei Shrine and call it "solved."
Camille
You shouldn't celebrate too early because the wounded Berenice is calling for help.
